contexts.text: Those in evil affections are in the Hells either shut up in workhouses, which are devoid of windows, but in which there is a light as from fatuous fire, or are in deserts...

Of such caverns, which are nothing but eternal workhouses, the universal Hell consists. Described. AR 153:12, Explained. AR 782:2. AR 835:2, Described. CL 80. CL 264:3. CL 461:8. TCR 281:11. See TCR 662:end. TCR 797:3. AE 1194:2, Described. Char 196:end, Described.
A just king... shuts up a part of them in workhouses.
